description: Per-step protocol map. The CLI intersects this map with .stackshift/installed.json protocols[] at install / repair time to inject pre-resolved 'Required / Recommended / Optional' lists into each workflow file's CLI:PROTOCOLS marker. Cross-cutting protocols (auto-validate-hook, modal-sheet) appear in 'crossCutting' instead — they are rendered into SKILL.md's CLI:CROSSCUT marker, not a single workflow step. auto-verify-hook is Step 4-specific (variant write postcondition) per its protocol doc, so it lives under steps.4 and contributes its action/done-when there. variant-naming-convention applies in both Step 2 (variantsList) and Step 4 (Variants map / filename) so it appears under both.
